package qa.generated;

import static com.microsoft.playwright.assertions.PlaywrightAssertions.assertThat;

import com.microsoft.playwright.Locator;
import com.microsoft.playwright.Page;
import com.microsoft.playwright.options.AriaRole;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import qa.generated.support.Env;
import qa.generated.support.QaPlaywrightTest;

/**
 * Generated by QA-CRAWLER from the flow "Ouvrir une fiche".
 * Run status at generation time: not executed.
 * Test data is generated per run (TestData, never a recorded value); literal values of the flow and
 * secrets come from the environment (QA_REPRO_<FLOW>_STEP_<n>).
 */
@DisplayName("Ouvrir une fiche")
class OuvrirUneFicheTest extends QaPlaywrightTest {

  @Test
  @DisplayName("Ouvrir une fiche")
  void ouvrirUneFiche() {
    page.navigate(Env.url("/"));

    // step 1
    page.getByRole(AriaRole.LINK, new Page.GetByRoleOptions().setName("Utilisateurs")).first().click();

    // step 2
    page.getByRole(AriaRole.LINK, new Page.GetByRoleOptions().setName("Utilisateur 1")).first().click();
    assertThat(page).hasURL(Pattern.compile("/users/[^/]+"));
    assertThat(page.getByRole(AriaRole.LINK, new Page.GetByRoleOptions().setName("Retour à la liste")).first()).isVisible();
    assertThat(page.getByRole(AriaRole.LINK, new Page.GetByRoleOptions().setName("Modifier")).first()).isVisible();

    // step 3
    assertThat(page).hasURL(Pattern.compile("/users/"));

  }
}
